Lap-Dance Lila, a chubby fuzzy pink plush teddy bear with round ears and button eyes, sitting coyly on a velvet chair with a feather boa, a winking face, a long credit-card receipt unrolling like a ribbon around her, framed by ornate floral curves. Colour palette: Absinthe green, peach and gold. The only character is a grown-up adult plush teddy bear: a stuffed toy with a plush bear head, round plush ears, button eyes, a stitched muzzle, visible stitched seams and plush paws, clearly a stuffed toy, not a human and not a real animal. No people anywhere in the image. Cheeky, saucy adult humour, witty not explicit, nothing graphic. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks or signatures anywhere. Vertical 3:4 trading-card art: put the bear's face and the main gag in the centre of the frame, slightly above middle, filling most of the frame; keep the outer edges simple.
plates.post: centre crop to 3:4, lanczos3 to 768x1024, webp q56 effort 6 smartSubsample (q stepped down from 74 to stay near 140 KB), thumb via npm run art:thumbs
